data.label: Chanel at Sephora, priced Nov 9, 2026
data.assumptions: Buy cost = today's Sephora price − 25%, + 5% Sephora uplift (Chanel's US prices are the same at Sephora and chanel.com; sizes Sephora didn't price were read from chanel.com). Amazon price = Buy Box, or lowest FBA when there's no Buy Box. ROI = (Amazon price − fees − .40 prep − buy cost) ÷ buy cost. Only 15%+ ROI shown.
notes: 93 Chanel sizes on Sephora US checked; 66 matched to an Amazon ASIN (mostly by barcode); 21 at 15%+ ROI today, 5 of those already ordered this sale.

Most Chanel Buy Boxes sit right at Sephora's full price, so at 25% off they earn only ~1–12%. Most rows here only clear 15% because there's no Buy Box and the lowest FBA offer is high — the notes give the ROI at the 90-day Buy Box average.

Left out: Platinum Égoïste deodorant stick (out of stock at Sephora). No Amazon listing found for Eau Splendide, Gabrielle L'Eau, Crush Absolu, Bleu L'Exclusif, Bleu Parfum 1.7 oz, Superleggera, N°5 Eau Première, the gift sets and Chance body oil.
